summary.t: Christmas bauble with a white lacquered MDF nativity scene, featuring a star and a laser-engraved «Merry Christmas» tag.

text.t: Christmas ornament with a white lacquered MDF nativity silhouette, featuring a small laser-engraved «Merry Christmas» tag and a star. With a golden cord, it is perfect for decorating the Christmas tree or as a gift.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
